title: Nearby cycles supported on a closed base
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian, let $k:F\hookrightarrow S$ be a closed immersion, and let a proper morphism $f:X\to S$ factor as $f=k f_F$ with $f_F:X\to F$. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring killed by an integer invertible on $S$. For $K\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ use [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles]. The induced $v:V_{f_F}\to V_f$ is the closed subtopos defined by the inverse image under $p_2:V_f\to S_{\mathrm{Et}}$ of $F_{\mathrm{Et}}$. Its module direct image $v_*$ is exact and fully faithful, preserves constructibility [def-trf-oriented-constructible-sheaf], and there is a natural isomorphism $R\Psi_fK\simeq v_*R\Psi_{f_F}K$. This isomorphism is compatible with ordinary nearby-cycle comparisons for arbitrary base changes of $S$.
